Updated entrypoint, config, test, duplicate, and risk maps
Respected DISK ONLY GitHub policy and did not read .env contents

commands: PowerShell artifact generation with ConvertTo-Json and Set-Content
tests: Product tests not run: inventory-only task with no product code edits

risks.description: INV-R1 .github/: Repo contains GitHub workflow/config surface while .f51/GITHUB_POLICY.json says DISK ONLY.
risks.mitigation: Keep ignoring GitHub tooling; do not run gh/git push/pull/fetch.

risks.description: INV-R2 Makefile: Makefile install-deps references requirements.txt, but only requirements-ci.txt is present.
risks.mitigation: Next config pass should reconcile install command with pyproject/requirements-ci.

risks.description: INV-R3 src/experts/technical_neural/expert/: Subpackage has Python files but no __init__.py, which can break package imports.
risks.mitigation: Contracts/refactor pass can add a minimal __init__.py if import path is intended.

risks.description: INV-R4 .env: .env exists on disk and was intentionally not read by inventory; treat as potential secret-bearing local file.
risks.mitigation: Keep gitignored, avoid screenshots/log dumps, rotate keys if exposure is suspected.

risks.description: INV-R5 .f51/tmp/mamba-ssm-src/: Operational tmp contains nested third-party source and its own .git metadata; can confuse searches/inventory and bloat disk.
risks.mitigation: Do not delete in this task; audit separately before cleanup.

risks.description: INV-R6 .env.example: 70 env-like names appear in code/docs but not in .env.example.
risks.mitigation: Run config/contracts pass to distinguish real env vars from constants and document the real ones.

risks.description: INV-R7 repository: 46 exact duplicate content groups found among small scanned files.
risks.mitigation: Use duplicate map before refactor; avoid deleting until contracts prove canonical owners.

next_step: Run /f51-contracts next to validate public APIs, config/env contracts, and route/pipeline import boundaries before any product patch.
